trace.question:
I didn't send any payment, because Cobalt Labs (V-222) has two approved invoices and I need you to tell me which one to pay:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-34905 | $5,983.10 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-36824 | $1,652.34 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Their other two invoices can't be paid now: INV-47379 ($3,033.57) is already paid, and INV-72843 ($7,093.97) is a draft still waiting for approval. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet.

Which invoice should I pay: INV-34905, INV-36824 or both? Once you confirm, I'll wire the full amount (or use ACH if wire isn't available) and pay each one only once. Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-36824, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-36824, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I wired Cobalt Labs the full $1,652.34 for invoice INV-36824 (due 2026-11-25) from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Status:** sent and confirmed. The invoice is now marked paid.
- **Paid only once:** there were no earlier payments from the operating account. I sent this one with a unique duplicate-protection key, so a retry can't charge twice.
- **Approval:** none needed, since it's under the $10,000 controller limit.

I didn't pay INV-34905 ($5,983.10) because it's under dispute, so it's still marked approved and unpaid.
